title: What my Timetastic spec forgot

segments.text: Here's how to reverse engineer Timetastic from a written spec. Claude passed all thirty-two checks, and my spec still had seven gaps.
The full spec is free at personal software factory dot com. If you build it, tell me what broke. I'm Sam. See you tomorrow.
